result.title: Beyond Patching: Consistent Circuit Discovery via Gradient Spectral Analysis
result.summary: Mechanistic interpretability seeks to reverse-engineer neural networks by identifying small, faithful subgraphs--circuits--that implement specific behaviors. The dominant paradigm scores each unit by replacing its clean activation with a corrupted counterpart as causal intervention. While effective, this approach rests on a brittle prerequisite: the structure prompt pairs are task-specific, expensive to engineer, and silently couple the discovered circuit to prompt-design choices. In this work, we propose Spectral Circuit Analysis (SCA), a gradient-spectral pipeline that achieves consistent circuit discovery along both axes: stable across input formulations of the same task, and natively exposing structure shared across tasks. Our contributions are threefold. First, we provide a counterfactual-free reframing of circuit discovery: causally relevant directions are recoverable from the spectral structure of forward gradients across paraphrases, with leading directions concentrating task signal and trailing ones absorbing paraphrase noise, yielding circuits tied to the task rather than the prompt. Second, we introduce SCA, a block-wise SVD pipeline that extracts a task subspace per architectural block and redistributes spectral energy onto constituent units via a consistency-weighted share, producing per-unit rankings competitive with attribution-patching baselines under strictly less supervision. Finally, on twelve circuit-discovery tasks in GPT-2 Small and Pythia-160M, SCA performs comparably or exceeds EAP-family methods under the standard recovery-score protocol and recovers IOI canonical heads with Precision@K = 1.0 in top-10 slices on GPT-2 Small; the same machinery extends to a unified cross-task analysis classifying units as universal, family-shared, or task-specific and exposing compositional structure invisible to per-task analyses.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Spectral Circuit Analysis（SCA），用前向梯度在释义间的谱结构替代反事实激活替换来定位电路：逐 block 做 SVD 提取任务子空间，并按一致性加权把谱能量分摊到单元上，在 GPT-2 Small 与 Pythia-160M 的十二个任务上做单元排序与跨任务共享结构分析。
AI.relevance_reason: 其核心是区分「承载任务信号的内部方向」与「随输入表述漂移的噪声方向」，并给出单元级贡献分配，可供核查能否用于判定 VLM 内部状态中的视觉证据与 latent 内容是否真的被答案使用，以及 latent 相似度中内容与表述因素的分离；但该工作仅在纯文本小模型上验证，向多模态推理期状态的迁移性待查。
